name: hero-platter
prompt: A generous East African feast platter photographed slightly from above: grilled nyama choma (roast goat/beef pieces), a mound of soft white ugali, vibrant sukuma wiki (braised collard greens), and fresh kachumbari tomato-onion salad, arranged on a large rustic ceramic plate. Warm, hearty, appetizing hero shot.

name: dish-jollof
prompt: West African jollof rice, deep reddish-orange smoky rice, served with a piece of grilled or fried chicken and fried sweet plantains on the side, on a simple enamel plate. Steam rising gently.

name: dish-injera
prompt: Ethiopian injera flatbread topped with colourful stews: spicy doro wat chicken, red misir wot lentils, sautéed greens and shiro, arranged as small mounds on the round spongy injera. Overhead editorial shot.

name: dish-matoke
prompt: Ugandan matoke: steamed and mashed green plantain stew in a rich groundnut-tomato sauce, served in a rustic clay bowl with a wooden spoon. Comforting home-cooked look.

name: dish-chapati-beans
prompt: Soft flaky Kenyan chapati stacked beside a bowl of hearty stewed beans (maharagwe) in coconut tomato sauce. Warm golden layers of the chapati clearly visible.

name: dish-pilau
prompt: Fragrant Swahili coast pilau rice with warm spices and tender beef, garnished with fried onions and served with kachumbari salad on the side. Rustic plating.

name: dish-tilapia
prompt: Whole grilled tilapia fish with crispy skin, served with a small mound of ugali and fresh kachumbari salad and a wedge of lime, on a woven mat. Coastal African style.

name: dish-fruit
prompt: A fresh tropical African fruit bowl: sliced ripe mango, papaya (pawpaw), pineapple, passion fruit halves and small bananas, on a light ceramic plate. Bright, juicy and healthy.

name: dish-breakfast
prompt: African breakfast scene: golden mandazi (fried dough) on a plate beside a steaming cup of spiced chai tea, with a small bowl of fresh fruit. Cozy morning light.

name: scan-plate
prompt: Close-up of a hand holding a smartphone over a plate of African food (ugali, greens and grilled meat), as if photographing the meal to analyse it. The phone screen is blank/neutral. Realistic, modern, clean lifestyle shot with shallow depth of field.
